draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (midlane→offlane).

coaching.headline: We won three lanes and lost the map — our ahead lanes kept skipping the objective fights, so kills never became objectives. Objectives 4.5k-43k.
coaching.team: Lane wasn't the problem: Sparrow (favored, ours all game), The Fey mid and Steel support all won outright. The problem was that our ahead players were never AT the fights that decided it. At 14.6m two winning lanes (Iggy, Sparrow) sat out the fight we lost; at 18.3m our ahead mid was absent; at 27.5m it was a bad trade with two winning lanes nowhere near it. The 23m fight we even opened a body down (The Fey had died 39s earlier). Sparrow's line says it all — 5/6/1, one assist the entire game means he farmed a side lane while objectives went 4.5k-43k against us. Add no healer drafted into their Phase, and the objective war was lost before it started. Two fixes: when a lane is ahead, group on the objective the moment the spike is up — and draft some sustain or anti-dive so we can actually hold those fights.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Three won lanes never converged — our ahead players kept farming while the team contested objectives a body or two short, and we lost the neutral war 4.5k-43k. Bring the won lanes to the prize as a five, and draft a healer or anti-dive support so the fights we take hold up.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow won lane outright (favored vs Revenant) and the spikes were on time (Vanquisher ~25m, Imperator ~36m) — but 5/6/1 with one assist all game is the whole loss in a line: the macro flagged Cuban Noobster alive-and-ahead but absent from the 14.6m fight while objectives went 10-22 and towers 3-10. The moment the Vanquisher is up, shove and group; a won carry lane that never joins the objective fights doesn't win the game.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Iggy offlane, 0/5/3 into their Murdock (10/4/5) — favored on paper but got run over, and at 14.6m and 18.3m Iggy was the ahead lane that didn't rotate to the fight. When trading with the bully across the lane isn't possible, concede farm, play safe, and group with the team instead of dying in side lane.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Steel support, 0/7/7 and team-low 8.3k — Willy Guggenheim won the Phase lane, but the draft brought no sustain into their Phase healer and the team never answered it. At 25.5m Willy was the ahead lane sitting out a fight the team lost. As the lead, call the group earlier: this comp needed a healer or anti-dive, and the won lanes needed to converge on the objectives the team was losing.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: The Fey mid, 4/5/5 — Mr_Meat31's lane vs Renna with the Wraith Leggings spike ~19m. Mr_Meat31 held that end up, but was flagged ahead-and-absent at 18.3m and 27.5m, and the 23.1m fight opened a body down after The Fey died 39s earlier — so the team kept fighting without their winning mid. Use those ahead windows to shove and rotate onto the objective, not to keep pushing a side wave.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera jungle, 7/7/5 — the Countess matchup tilted theirs late, and with objectives going 4.5k-43k the jungle had to set and contest more of them. Xeebs was in the fights, but they were the wrong ones — fight on top of Fangtooth/Prime so the kills buy the objective. Build note: no armor (Overlord/Basilisk/Rapture) again — finish that core to survive the late fights.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.8s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Phase. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,116 hero damage a minute, more than 78% of Murdock offlane players this patch (28% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Imperator.
Murdock dealt 33,471 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +217 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Iggy & Scorch (level 17 estimated: about 95 physical armor, 83 after penetration) and Khaimera (level 17 estimated: about 93 physical armor, 81 after penetration) that is about 7% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).

Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
